The contract requires regular-file os.stat fallback without transcript reads, explicit AfterAgent-to-Stop normalization for AGY, empty bounded Codex SessionEnd behavior, root-stable registrations, non-persistence of session/transcript identifiers, and the minimal source/mirror allowlist needed for deterministic sync. Collection retained all 127 sequence-2 cases and added three focused cases (130 total). Fresh controls: the sentinel exited 1 with 1 failed; the full suite exited 1 with 127 failed and 3 passed; two fixture-only controls exited 0 with 2 passed. Official documentation lookup informed fixture fields only and is not runtime/provider execution proof.
